title: com.responder_replace arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Takes the slot even from a live holder: claimed requests of the older generation go back to queued, in_progress ones become outcome_unknown, accepted ones are held unless transferred. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

expectedGeneration.description: The slot generation the caller read in com.status; another one is revision_conflict. The new holder gets generation + 1.

requests.description: Accepted requests of this Project and capability the new holder continues, each under a new attempt.

checkpoint.description: Where the work stands, posted as a fenced reply on each transferred request's thread.

transfer.description: The explicit checkpoint transfer; without it, accepted requests stay held and the new holder does not continue them.
